facts.statement: For the month of October, buying a $10 Station Cash card at Walmart and redeeming it during October gave the player a Walmart Shirt.
facts.quote: Buy a $10 Station Cash card at Walmart, redeem it during the month of October, and get your own Walmart Shirt!

article_summaries.title: October Special: Get Your Own Walmart Shirt!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post promoting a October promotion in which buying a $10 Station Cash card at Walmart and redeeming it during October earned a Walmart Shirt. It is a limited-time retail tie-in for the running game, and the page gives no item stats or quest details.
